'''Rorworr's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. Sometime after his child, [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], was born in [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]], he was assigned to act as an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] for [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. His station allowed his son to attend school in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], at the [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]].

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Rorworr's father actively spoke out against [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. He subsequently disappeared without a trace. By the time the Empire was defeated at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Rorworr had still not learned of his father's ultimate fate.
